newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent trades at Sept Brent - 29 cents.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent trades at Sept Brent - 29 cents.

text.p: A Dated Brent cargo traded on Thurday, the third for the day, at a much lower price of September Brent -29 cents, dealers said.
A European major bought the August 20-22 loader from a trading company, the sources said.
Earlier Dated Brent loading August 26-28 sold at seven cents below September Brent, following on from a deal for an August 27-29 cargo at five cents below September.
Buyers and sellers were the same for both of the earlier deals.
Both Aug 29-31 cargoes due to turn wet on Thursday, the last from the August programme, were kept early by equity holders Shell and Exxon, the traders said.
